Welcome to Star Buds Weed Dispensary in Lawton Oklahoma! We are a premier medical cannabis dispensary and your destination for all of your medical dispensary needs! We are conveniently located on NW Cache Rd just a quarter mile west of Sheridan Rd. Our Dispensaries offer medical marijuana consumers an industry leading selection of products from the nations top quality brands and growers. We maintain a large inventory of cannabis flower, edibles, extracts, concentrates, tinctures, topicals, and more! We seek to have a selection of products for everyone whether you are a first time user or a seasoned cannabis consumer. Here at our Lawton dispensary our hope is to create a memorable dispensary experience. Our aim is to provide our customers with the knowledge and insight necessary to make informed decisions on the products they need. Our compassionate and knowledgeable staff is here to help guide you through the process, so you get exactly what you need at the best possible price.

Looking for extra speed and convenience? Skip the line and place your order online to pick up in store! Looking to save money on your next visit to one of our dispensaries? take advantage of all of the current ways to save by checking out our deals page that gets updated regularly!

Star Buds Lawton Medical Weed Dispensary is proud to serve cannabis consumers in Comanche County to include the communities of Cache, Chattanooga, Elgin, Faxon, Fort Sill, Frederick, Indiahoma, Lawton, Manitou Medicine Park, Meers, Mountain Park, Roosevelt, Snyder, Walters and the surrounding areas.
Come Visit Our Medical Weed Dispensary!

Are you looking for the best weed dispensary in the Lawton area? Welcome to Star Buds Dispensary Lawton, Comanche County’s premier medical marijuana store! Our storefront is located at 2629 NW Cache Rd, Lawton, OK 73505 just north of Cameron University and just a short drive away from Comanche County Fairgrounds and Lawton Country Club. There are also a number of local attractions nearby such as the Museum of the Great Plains, Comanche National Museum and Cultural Center, and Elmer Thomas Park.

At Star Buds Lawton medical marijuana dispensary, we strive to provide each customer with a unique and rewarding experience when it comes to shopping for medical cannabis. We rise high above other dispensaries in the area through our premium cannabis products and outstanding customer service. Our dispensary has a range of top-quality medical marijuana products. These products include cannabis flower strains, edibles, concentrates, tinctures, topicals, smoking accessories, vapes, CBD products, and carts/cartridges. Star Buds Dispensaries was created in 2013 with a goal in mind to change the way people think about cannabis. Our store is open 7 days a week 8:00am to 12:00 am 365 days a year to add to your convenience. Stop in today at one of our 7 Oklahoma locations and experience the difference with Star Buds dispensaries!

We also offer online ordering and in-store pick-up every day for your convenience! We even have an amazing rewards program and daily specials throughout the week that’ll help you save on all of your favorite cannabis products! We encourage you to stop by Star Buds Lawton and experience why we are the best dispensary in Oklahoma!

Know Before You Go…

This is my first time visiting Star Buds. What should I bring with me? All visitors must be at least 18 years of age with a valid medical card and must provide a valid photo ID. We take cash and debit cards and there is also an ATM inside our dispensary for your convenience. ​

Is your dispensary open late?

We understand that normal operating hours are not always convenient for our consumers with busy lifestyles, which is why our dispensary is open Monday through Sunday from 8:00 am to 12:00 am.

Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?

We run product specials seven days a week, and our loyalty rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED card holders and veterans with a discount upon request.
